user.title: Select media player
user.description: Choose one media player to track independently and give the tracker a name.

settings.title: Tracking settings
settings.description: Optional conditions restrict tracking. Add each application name or id: identifier separately. Aliases pair an identifier with a display name.

data.app_sensors: Optional app sensors (names or id: identifiers)

condition.title: Tracking condition
condition.description: Set the required condition for {entity}. Use the raw Home Assistant state.

reconfigure.title: Replace media player
reconfigure.description: Choose a replacement source. Existing history and tracker sensor IDs are kept. For a fresh history, add a separate tracker instead.
